patches.value: PENDING_AUDIT_B. Space is the coordinate product Fin n → ℝ with its product Lebesgue volume; its finite-dimensional product norm gives the same topology and smoothness as Euclidean ℝ^n. Values use EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m), so all displayed norms and inner products are exactly Euclidean. Indices are zero-based Fin n. u is a total ambient extension, assumed smooth only on the open positive-time domain; all claims are restricted to positive times. Coordinate derivatives use Fréchet derivatives evaluated on Pi.single j 1, and time derivatives use deriv of the fixed-space curve. wLap, wDensity and wEnergy are precisely the componentwise Laplacian, unhalved density and Lebesgue energy. Totalized integrals do not assert finiteness: that is separately proved in N002 and P. wGeometry, wLocal and wNice merely bundle explicit support, box, continuity, integrability and bound propositions; none is an assumed theorem. T010 is the explicit checked measure-transport obligation for the coordinate-product split used in the FTC/Fubini proof.
